scope: Settings/About/Help/First Start command entry; source page mapping/defaults and Remote No Fetch; owned repository discovery/adoption; reused native Settings/wizard drafts; initial User/Authentication read bootstrap and actual cancellation drain.
implementation: Primary aliases settings/about/help/firststartwizard; source page option scoped to Settings/Wizard, settings single-path validation, typed presets retained across authorized path-file resolution and selection. First Start is an application utility, with the existing About icon, without adding a Finder-menu preference bit.

About, manual Help, First Start and outside-repository global Settings do not require Git. A bounded permission-aware marker scan precedes Git creation; root/empty-path termination prevents parent traversal from cycling beyond the filesystem root.

Repository Settings captures original window/grants, resolves linked metadata before Git, refuses invalid scope or changed Settings context, and uses normal adoption/rollback. Reused page/window/cache preserves modified drafts; busy pages/child questions refuse navigation.

Case-sensitive pinned Settings page names map to native pages. Repository default is Git; outside default is General. Remote/Issue Tracker Config are conditional. Windows-only win11menu falls back. Explicit Remote suppresses its post-save Fetch question and uses owning preferences.

Common adoption retains an explicit handoff owner and uses its cancellation instead of observing a subsequently selected workspace window. Retained Clone/Init handoff regression checks cover this shared change.

New wizard starts on page 0-4 with Language fallback; explicit startup suppresses automatic Language race. Repeated entry retains its existing draft/page. Initial User/Authentication bootstrap selected-engine global configuration through existing permissions, without writing engine/identity/helper settings. Close cancels reads and retains accounting through actual drain; late results are fenced.
